card.name: Words just before death or fatal
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation right where the next word is likely to be death, fatal, or mortality. Seen after severe disease descriptions and in warnings about life-threatening effects.

modes.label: Link before fatal outcome
modes.description: A short word like a, and, may, or with after a severe disease description, where fatal or death comes next.
modes.example: These drugs have transformed<< a>> fatal disease into a chronic one.

modes.label: Life-or-death phrasing
modes.description: Words in phrases like difference between life and death, or life-threatening or fatal effects.
modes.example: which can sometimes mean the<< difference>> between life and death.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict death, mortality, and survival words next.
card.plain: It lights up on small words just before the text says death or fatal.
